summary: Validated OPS ride-booking bug fixes and multi-driver dispatch. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests passed (auth for 3 seeded roles + signup + drivers/nearby for Bike/Auto/Car + Open-Meteo weather + POST /api/rides with dispatch_count=5). Frontend: home page loads without any 'Compiled with problems' or 'Map container is already initialized' overlays; Leaflet map renders with OpenStreetMap tiles (6 tiles loaded) and attribution; price sync verified across Bike/Auto/Car — card price, Total (Cash) box and Book button all match exactly (Bike ₹236, Auto ₹341, Car ₹527). Multi-driver dispatch UI shows '5 captains notified'.

issues: Active ride shows CASH ₹218 (prior booking) while new selection shows ₹527 — expected because the two panels represent different rides, but could be confusing; consider labeling clearly

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1099 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, rides, drivers, rentals, delivery) for maintainability
Some anonymous frontend requests return 401 in console before auth cookie/token is set — consider gating those calls behind auth state to reduce console noise
seed_data_creation: None (used pre-seeded accounts; signup test uses ephemeral uuid emails)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_ops_backend.py covers auth, drivers/nearby, weather, and ride multi-dispatch. RideCreate expects pickup_location (str) + destination_location (str) + pickup_coords/destination_coords (dict) + vehicle_type + distance_km. All Leaflet/react-leaflet 5.0.0 issues are resolved with the current MapView.jsx implementation.
